curriculum.note: DC adopted the Common Core State Standards verbatim; expectation identifiers are the canonical CCSS codes (e.g., 6.NS.A.1). Unlike Maryland's 2025 MCCRS re-domained framework, DC retains the legacy domain letters RP/NS/EE/G/SP/F.

source_notes: The District of Columbia adopted the Common Core State Standards; OSSE publishes DC standards as the CCSS verbatim.
Expectation identifiers follow the canonical CCSS scheme {grade}.{domain}.{cluster}.{number}; the inventory unit is the top-level standard (lettered sub-parts are not enumerated).
Scope summaries are editorial paraphrases of the CCSS statements; reviewers must compare them with official wording before accepting any mapping.
OSSE adoption was July 2010; implementation began SY 2011-2012 and was complete by SY 2014-2015. The inventory_as_of date is not a standards version or school-year code.

2026-10-12 completeness correction: Grade 8 Geometry includes 8.G.C.9 (volume of cylinders, cones, spheres), omitted from the earlier 80-row draft; authoritative CCSS Grade 8 Geometry domain lists nine standards.
